title: Refract
summary: A source-grounded workspace for reading papers, practicing recall, comparing evidence, and running literature-linked statistical analyses.
landingDeck: Refract connects five implemented workspaces—Reader, Index, Compare, Review, and Stats—through a shared session containing sources, saved passages, review attempts, datasets, and analysis runs.
landingHighlights: Keeps PDF passages, saved evidence, questions, and cross-paper comparisons linked to their source documents.
Grades free recall on core claim, supporting detail, and faithfulness, then schedules later review with FSRS state.
Profiles uploaded data, checks leakage, compares mean, linear, and Random Forest baselines, and stores MAE, RMSE, and R² with each run.
problem: Research decisions lose traceability when PDFs, excerpts, review notes, dataset assumptions, and model results live in separate tools.
approach: Refract uses a shared session ID to connect papers, passage-level evidence, comparison prompts, recall attempts, uploaded datasets, and statistical runs across five focused workspaces.
output: A React/Vite frontend and FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL records, ChromaDB retrieval, object storage, passage-grounded chat, structured recall grading, FSRS scheduling, and a battery remaining-useful-life analysis workflow.

methodology.evaluation: Review attempts retain the prompt, response, confidence, rubric scores, feedback, and source reveal mode. Statistical runs retain profiles, leakage checks, baselines, model metrics, and literature alignment notes.
methodology.boundary: The repository implements the research workflow and evaluation records. A planned retention study and production predictive-maintenance deployment have not been completed.

role: I designed and built the session model, document reader, evidence index, comparison workflow, active-recall review pipeline, and statistical analysis surfaces.

pageSections.title: Read, recall, compare, and analyze inside one research session
pageSections.description: Every saved passage, review attempt, comparison, dataset profile, and model result carries the session and source identifiers needed to trace it.
pageSections.context: The product currently implements Reader, Index, Compare, Review, and Stats as separate interfaces over shared research state.

pageSections.title: Ask a question beside the exact passage that should answer it
pageSections.description: The Reader displays the PDF, lets the user select text, and sends the selected passage and document identity into grounded chat or question generation.
pageSections.caption: Implemented Reader interaction: a battery paper remains visible while the assistant generates diagnostic questions from the selected material.

pageSections.title: Five interfaces handle five distinct research tasks

items.label: Reader
items.title: Read and question a paper
items.body: Open a PDF, select a passage, ask a grounded question, transcribe microphone input, and save evidence.

items.label: Index
items.title: Find saved evidence
items.body: Browse passages and notes retained from the active session with their document references.

items.label: Compare
items.title: Synthesize selected sources
items.body: Run a research question across a bounded paper set and retain source coverage with the comparison.

items.label: Review
items.title: Practice retrieval
items.body: Answer from memory, rate confidence before grading, receive a three-part score, reveal the source, and schedule the next review.

items.label: Stats
items.title: Audit and model data
items.body: Profile a dataset, identify leakage risks, compare baselines, and store metrics and visualizations with the analysis run.

pageSections.title: A review attempt records memory, confidence, evidence, and scheduling state

items.title: Prompt from source material
items.body: Create a recall item from a saved passage or research concept.

items.title: Answer before source reveal
items.body: Capture the learner's free-recall response and confidence rating.

items.title: Grade three dimensions
items.body: Score the core claim, supporting detail, and faithfulness to the source through structured output.

items.title: Show evidence and feedback
items.body: Reveal the passage according to the selected mode and identify rubric hits, omissions, and corrections.

items.title: Schedule the next attempt
items.body: Update FSRS review state and retain the complete attempt for later analysis or human grading.

pageSections.title: The selected question and paper set define the synthesis scope
pageSections.description: Compare organizes agreements, disagreements, and coverage across chosen sources, then saves the result to the active session.
pageSections.caption: Cross-paper comparison interface from the public repository.

pageSections.title: Battery analysis begins with data quality and leakage checks
pageSections.description: The Stats workflow profiles variables, audits predictor timing, creates a mean baseline, then compares Linear Regression and Random Forest with MAE, RMSE, and R².
pageSections.caption: Battery remaining-useful-life workspace with analysis outputs linked to the active research session.

pageSections.title: Each result stores the information needed for later review

items.label: Retrieval
items.title: Source and passage IDs
items.body: Grounded answers and saved evidence retain the paper and passage used.

items.label: Recall
items.title: Rubric and confidence
items.body: Review logs include the learner answer, confidence, dimension scores, feedback, model, prompt, and source reveal mode.

items.label: Human review
items.title: Export for agreement checks
items.body: A grading export supports human scoring and inter-rater reliability sampling.

items.label: Statistics
items.title: Inputs, settings, and metrics
items.body: Analysis records include dataset identity, predictor choices, audit notes, models, and evaluation measures.

pageSections.title: A shared session joins the interface, retrieval, records, and files
pageSections.description: React/Vite provides the five workspaces; FastAPI coordinates PostgreSQL records, ChromaDB retrieval, and stored PDFs and datasets.

pageSections.title: Implemented instrumentation precedes outcome claims
pageSections.description: The product records learning and analysis behavior; it has not completed the planned retention study or a production maintenance deployment.
pageSections.markdown: The repository includes active-recall grading, FSRS state, human-grade export, statistical baselines, and run-level provenance. Claims about improved long-term retention or deployed predictive-maintenance performance require future studies beyond the current implementation.
